name: mediflow
description: MediFlow - Course assignment for Organization of Commercial Services on the Internet (Poznan University of Technology)

scripts.win-start: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0" && node server/server.js
scripts.win-dev: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0" && nodemon server/server.js

author: MediFlow Team
